_documentation.purpose: Synthetic schema example only; replace every source/identity/event field with permitted provider data.
_documentation.csv: Select CSV plus this metadata JSON with events omitted. Numeric columns: revision, period, clock, xG, xA, postShotXG, startX, startY, endX, endY. Use | within qualifiers/providerTags.
_documentation.clock: Seconds elapsed in the specified period, not cumulative video time.
_documentation.directions: Fixed input needs matchId:teamId:period -> left/right for each located event; normalisation rotates both axes when attacking left.
_documentation.coverage: Complete/partial/unavailable must describe the actual supplied fields. Missing is not zero. No pass endpoints, xG or recipient may be invented.
_documentation.revisions: Keep canonical id and sourceId stable; increase revision for corrections. deleted is a boolean tombstone.

source.attribution: Bang On synthetic data for validating the import schema; no real match performance is represented.

notes: Synthetic schema fixture only. One pass is deliberately supplied; no player-quality claim.

minutes.basis: Synthetic fixture denominator, not real playing time
